meta.title: Backroom A+B — missing-coordinate follow-up (six source records)
meta.google_maps_access: Google Maps search/place UI was attempted via web research browser but returned inaccessible; direct Google Maps URLs included for review only. Five map references cross-checked against published cartographic records or source map links. Not represented as Google's own confirmed GPS data.
meta.owner_rule: General park/road/station map pin is acceptable; never claim a broad landmark pin is exact cruising place.

records.name: Pădure Dumbravița–Timișoara
records.identity: Pădurea Verde forest on the northeast side of Timișoara near Dumbrăvița; source cruising track/entry unknown.
records.coordinate_origin: Outdooractive editorial mapped Pădurea Verde forest, corroborated by Timișoara 2026 park/forest project and Dumbrăvița municipality plan.
records.caveat: A published forest centre, not a verified location within the forest where men meet. Do not confuse with industrial archaeological Padurea Verde-UMT site.

records.name: Ponte fiume Reno a Borgo Panigale
records.identity: Reno River bridge Pontelungo, at Via Emilia Ponente and Via del Triumvirato in Bologna.
records.coordinate_origin: Original Gays-Cruising Italian site embedded directions map, preserved in 18-location verification research.
records.caveat: Source point at/near bridge, not proven legal access path to park under bridge.

records.name: Oasi – Lungadige (Est)
records.identity: Eastern Adige bank in Verona; directory calls it a distinct eastern 'Oasi' from western riverside site, but no reliable specific stretch or entry was found in accessible source text.
records.coordinate_origin: No original precise source pin recovered; named riverside region exists but east-bank designation alone spans multiple plausible sections.
records.caveat: Google Maps direct search page inaccessible through research browser; must not substitute Lazzaretto or entire Parco dell'Adige Sud map point because those are separate named areas. This is an unresolved geographic identity, not a failure to retrieve coordinate from a known place.

records.name: Zona Industriale – Ca' di Mazze
records.identity: Via Ca' di Mazze, Verona 37134, approximately 1.6-km street through Palazzina industrial area; no exact lay-by/meeting section identified.
records.coordinate_origin: Italian mapped street directory reports reference point 45.40749,11.02056; independently confirmed by another mapping site.
records.caveat: Street midpoint rather than original cruising directory pin. Possible overlap with Palazzina listing remains unconfirmed.

records.name: Świecko Stacja Paliw Shell, boczna droga
records.identity: Shell service station at Świecko 36, on DK29 near Słubice; source claims an adjacent side road, not the pumps/forecourt.
records.coordinate_origin: myLPG station confirmed 6 November 2026 and independent property/Polish mapping references Shell Świecko 36 near same coordinates.
records.caveat: The exact 'boczna droga' side road is not mapped from original; do not treat petrol station as a public cruising destination.

records.name: Parking río Llobregat El Prat
records.identity: Source directs from Barcelona via C-31 exit 194B to roundabout, access road toward river and small parking on right.
records.coordinate_origin: Exact original directory directions map preserved in 18-location verification research.
records.caveat: Original map destination, not current parking permission or independent confirmation of cruising.
